item_short_desc: Rothco’s Paracord Pace Counter is a versatile tool designed to help you accurately measure and keep track of your steps during outdoor activities. Made from durable 12.25 inch polyester paracord, this compact pace counter features a total of 13 black counting beads—9 on the long side and 4 on the short side. These beads help you calculate distances covered by sliding them down the cord with each 100 paces. The paracord itself is constructed with a strong 7-strand core, providing durability and versatility.
description: Rothco’s Paracord Pace Counter is a versatile tool designed to help you accurately measure and keep track of your steps during outdoor activities. Made from durable 12.25 inch polyester paracord, this compact pace counter features a total of 13 black counting beads—9 on the long side and 4 on the short side. These beads help you calculate distances covered by sliding them down the cord with each 100 paces. The paracord itself is constructed with a strong 7-strand core, providing durability and versatility for various uses beyond just pacing. A convenient black hinge clip allows you to easily attach the pace counter to your gear, ensuring it’s always within reach. Whether hiking, trekking, or navigating in the field, Rothco’s Paracord Pace Counter offers a simple, reliable way to keep track of your distance.
